% mleftright's \left and \right, which set an empty open atom and a close
% atom: no space between two matrices, after a matrix before a comma, or
% around \left( \right) after a letter or an operator; a relation's and a
% binary operator's space kept; a script on the close atom; a fraction's
% denominator and a root's index that are one delimited formula
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{mleftright}
\mleftright
\begin{document}
$\begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$,
$\begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix},$
$\left(\frac{a}{b}\right),$
$x\left(a\right)y$,
$\log\left(x\right)$,
$a=\left(b\right)^2+c$,
$a+\left[b\right]$,
$\Bigl(a\Bigr),$
$\frac{b}{\left(a\right)}$,
$\sqrt[\left(n\right)]{x}$
\end{document}
